critical_findings.finding: Owner-to-scope equality is enforced, but membership in the verified facts.reviews is checked using path pairs only. The four owner source/review refs are not directly verified or included as full refs in the guard inventory. Hence verified source bytes and canonical registered refs can disagree.
critical_findings.demonstrated_counterexamples: Four reference keys each tested with unchanged path but wrong sha256 and wrong bytes, synchronizing owner and scope (and worker review ref if needed), while facts.reviews retains original valid refs: all eight mutations accepted by AST transform.
critical_findings.impact: CP366/OW170 can register unverified digest/size references although guard holds another version, breaking exact reviewed provenance.
critical_findings.fix: Compare complete typed ref dictionaries for each source pair and independent-review pair against the corresponding facts.reviews member; enforce exact path/sha256/bytes equality. Keep scope-owner-worker ref equality. Validate corrected v3 against all eight ref mismatch counterexamples.

passed_in_scope.read_ref_and_held_facts_static_review: read_ref now returns exact size/hash checked bytes; held facts bytes compared before parsing; scope and old scope parsed from guard-held buffers.
